chapter_title_en: The Auction Ends, The Stakes Rise
chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 299 – Ji Ning Wins the Peacock Plume and Fires Up His Primaltwin
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning wins the Peacock Plume in a fierce bidding war, buys 396 Heaven-ranked flying swords for his Primaltwin, and unknowingly becomes the target of Floating Cloud Immortal’s ambush. Xiyue Commandery Princess requests a secret meeting.
og_title: Desolate Era Ch. 299 – The Peacock Plume Is His, But the Danger Outside Is Real
og_description: Ji Ning secures the Peacock Plume, sells his carriage for flying swords, and faces an inevitable confrontation with Floating Cloud Immortal and a mysterious princess.
twitter_title: Desolate Era 299 – Ji Ning’s Shopping Spree Sets Up a Deadly Ambush
twitter_description: The auction is over—Ji Ning has the Peacock Plume and 396 Heaven-ranked swords. But Floating Cloud Immortal waits outside, ready to kill.

lore_anchors.definition: A rare, consumable treasure that can greatly increase a cultivator's chance of surviving heavenly tribulation by providing a protective barrier or other tribulation-resisting effects.
A monthly high-stakes auction hosted by Heavenly Treasures Mountain's headquarters where rare and unique treasures sometimes appear.
The three-legged solar bird in Chinese mythology that dwells in the Sunstar; often used as a poetic term for the sun itself.
An Immortal-ranked treasure that can nurture 'Heavenly Fire' up to the first grade, usable repeatedly but requiring long recovery periods between uses.
A puppet carriage with combat power at the Primal Daoist level, formerly owned by Shaoyan Nong; sold by Ji Ning for Primordial Liquid.
Mass-produced magic swords that meet basic sharpness and toughness standards but lack special properties; offered at a fixed discount by Heavenly Treasures Mountain.
A noble of the Grand Xia Dynasty who has been watching Ji Ning throughout the assembly and now urgently requests a private meeting.
A Loose Immortal who covets the Peacock Plume and plans to kill Ji Ning as soon as he leaves the Heavenly Treasures Mountain.
A mid-range sword formation technique using multiple flying swords in concert; Ji Ning's Primaltwin is preparing to use it with Heaven-ranked flying swords.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Shaoyan Xiushui stop bidding at five million jin?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He calculated that the Peacock Plume was not worth more than that; with the same wealth he could buy other Immortal-ranked treasures to help survive his tribulation, and wasting money out of spite would harm his long-term cultivation path.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Ji Ning need so many Heaven-ranked flying swords?
cultural_notes_faq.a: His Primaltwin practices the Lesser Thousand Sword Formation, which derives power from both the quality and quantity of swords. 396 Heaven-ranked swords will create a devastating sword formation far beyond what Earth-ranked swords could achieve.
She is a noblewoman of the Grand Xia royal clan who has shown keen interest in Ji Ning; her urgent request for a private meeting suggests a deep personal connection that will be revealed soon.
